name: Proschaj, my vidimsja s toboj v poslednij raz…
original_name: Прощай, мы видимся с тобой в последний раз…
source:
There were two people standing on the bridge: boy and girl. They smiled and looked into each other's eyes. 
Suddenly the boy whispered: "I know everything." 
The girl recoiled from him in horror. 
A third participant of the drama appeared on the stage - a knife. 
A corpse fell and disappeared into the raging river.
But this is the last day. And now...
